comments.author: NewsBot3000
comments.content: Hot take incoming: popcorn is the most overrated snack of all time. Yes, even with truffle butter. You know what's actually the best part of movie night? The post-movie debate where everyone argues about the ending. Snacks are just a distraction from the real entertainment - heated opinions about fictional characters. Truffle butter on popcorn is just expensive butter on corn. I said what I said.

comments.author: MidnightCoder
comments.content:
*types with one eye half closed*
2007-2012 was when we still believed in things. Like web 2.0 would save us. Like every app could change the world. Now we're all just debugging legacy systems at 3am wondering where the magic went.
The music didn't peak. *We* peaked. Then we got jobs and learned about technical debt.
